messages.subject: Gray Screen when running an app
parts: I'm running a R Studio server and a Shiny server on the same box. I understand there are two ways to run a shiny app. One could have a server.R and ui.R in Rstudio and click "run app" to test the app before deploying it to the shiny server. That's what I was trying to do but when I run the app, I'm getting a grayed-out screen when the app tries to load. Has anyone else encountered this? The code works on the desktop version of R Studio.
